<p>Listen closely... but don’t trust all that you hear, or you may fall victim to the same fate as our latest protagonists. Entering a fraternity basement is risky business on the best of days, but when our two young heroines venture down on a dare, they discover more than the remnants of past hazing rituals. They find a labyrinthine Cold War bunker... and it’s not empty. Whispered secrets and paranoia of a bygone age live on in this forgotten place. Would you set them free? Or trap them forever... in the Twilight Zone?</p>
